title: Verona — Ecommerce Platform
description: A full-featured storefront and admin dashboard with cart, checkout, and inventory management, built on a NestJS API and a Nuxt front end.

title: TaskFlow API
description: A multi-tenant project management API with role-based access control, webhooks, and rate limiting, documented with OpenAPI.

title: PulseBoard Analytics
description: A real-time analytics dashboard with live charts and alerting, built with Vue and PrimeVue components on a WebSocket data feed.

title: Nimbus Booking System
description: An appointment scheduling platform with calendar sync, automated reminders, and a customer-facing booking widget.

title: DevLog CLI
description: A command-line tool for developers to log daily progress and generate weekly standup summaries from git history.
